mechanism_narrative: When the 12-month change in the CPIAUCSL exceeds +2%, the S&P 500 forward 60-day return is expected to be positive due to anticipated inflation normalization and reduced policy tightening.
failure_condition: Over a 60-day window following the trigger, SPX 60-day returns are not statistically higher than the prior 60-day average (t-test p > 0.05).

mechanism_narrative: Rising employment momentum as measured by PAYEMS exceeding 150,000 monthly suggests labor market strength, which is associated with positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 days.
failure_condition: In 20-day windows after the trigger, SPX 20-day returns are negative and statistically significant (t-test p < 0.05).

mechanism_narrative: A sustained monthly increase in HOUST above 1,200 indicates rising industrial demand, which predicts a positive S&P 500 forward return over the next 5 trading days.
failure_condition: Over the 5-day horizon, SPX 5-day returns are not positive or are significantly negative (p > 0.05).

mechanism_narrative: A monthly decline in INDPRO below 110 suggests softening supply-side pressures, which is associated with a positive S&P 500 forward return over the next 20 days.
failure_condition: SPX 20-day returns are negative in all instances where INDPRO < 110 (no positive cases).

mechanism_narrative: Consecutive monthly FEDFUNDS readings above 4% indicate persistent tightening, which predicts negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 60 days.
failure_condition: SPX 60-day returns are not significantly negative (p > 0.05) during the tightening period.

mechanism_narrative: A sharp rise in UNRATE above 4% in a single month signals labor market stress, which is expected to produce negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 days.
failure_condition: SPX 20-day returns are not negative or are only marginally negative (p > 0.10).

mechanism_narrative: Simultaneous increases in GDPC1 and RSAFS above their 12-month averages suggest robust demand across sectors, predicting a positive S&P 500 forward return over the next 20 days.
candidate_trigger: GDPC1 monthly > 12mo avg AND RSAFS monthly > 12mo avg
failure_condition: SPX 20-day returns are not positive in >50% of such triggered windows (binomial test p > 0.05).

mechanism_narrative: A prolonged monthly decline in GDPC1 of at least 5% indicates softening demand absorption, which is expected to yield negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 60 days in a recession regime.
candidate_trigger: GDPC1 monthly decline >= 5% for 3 consecutive months AND recession regime
failure_condition: SPX 60-day returns are not negative or are only slightly negative (p > 0.10) during the trigger period.
